_doc: Maps friendly icon names -> hosted Mural asset photoURLs, per board (muralId). Mural only renders PhotoWidgets whose photoURL points at an asset IT hosts. So an icon must be pasted onto a board ONCE (via the image pen), which makes Mural host it; capture the resulting photoURL here and the pen can then reference it in generated diagrams on that same board. photoURL is board-relative: /api/murals/{workspace}/{muralNum}/assets/{workspace}/{assetId}.png
